Class DockerService

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.maven.services.DockerService
@Singleton public class DockerService extends Object
Provides methods to work with Docker images.

    • startAndWait

      @Internal public void startAndWait(String containerId, String imageId, Integer timeoutSeconds) throws IOException
      Starts a container and waits for it to exit with status 0. Otherwise, logs its output and fails.
      Parameters:
      containerId - the container
      imageId - the image of the container, for the error message
      timeoutSeconds - the timeout in seconds for the container to finish execution
      Throws:
      IOException - if the container does not exit with status 0 within the timeout
      Since:
      5.1.0

    • removeImage

      @Internal public void removeImage(String image)
      Removes an image reference without force: a tag, or the ID of an image that at most one tag refers to. Docker deletes the image when no tag refers to it anymore, and fails instead of removing an image that other tags refer to or that a container uses.
      Parameters:
      image - the tag or the image ID
      Since:
      5.1.0
